body.name: Covering paired partition and focal set
body.construction: Given \((L,a,b)\), choose ordered partitions \(\mathscr B=(B_1,\ldots,B_L)\) of \(B\) and \(\mathscr S=(S_1,\ldots,S_L)\) of \(S\) with \(|B_\ell|=a_\ell\) and \(|S_\ell|=b_\ell\); set \(P=(\mathscr B,\mathscr S)\) and \(U_P=\bigcup_{\ell=1}^{L}(B_\ell\times S_\ell)\).
